errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Jahre von 1995 bis 2023 und die Jahre 1991 bis 2023
errors.evidence: The x-axis range is incorrectly described as starting from 1995, but the image clearly shows the range from 1991 to 2023 for both diagrams.
The description incorrectly assigns green to Länder and gray to Gemeinden, but the image shows Länder as violet and Gemeinden as green.
The description incorrectly assigns gray to Gemeinden, but the image shows Gemeinden as green.
The description does not explicitly state that the figure shows investments of Gebietskörperschaften in relation to GDP or distinguishes between gross and net investments.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of two diagrams (left for gross investments, right for net investments).
The description omits the right diagram entirely, which shows net investments and their trends over time.
The description does not mention the high initial values in the early 1990s (over 3% of GDP) for gross investments.
The description does not mention the decline in gross investments to about 2.5% by 2000.
The description does not mention the relatively stable trend of gross investments between 2% and 3% after 2000.
The description does not mention that net investments in the early 1990s were around 0.7% of GDP.
The description does not mention that net investments occasionally fell into the negative range.
The description does not mention that net investments mostly ranged between 0 and 0.5% after the 1990s.
The description does not mention the slight upward trend in net investments since 2015.
The description does not mention that net investments never exceeded 0.6% and are currently just above zero.

errors.text_span: Der Anteil des Bundes stagniert zwischen 2001 und 2023 bei rund 2,5 % des BIP
errors.evidence: The description states stagnation at 2.5%, but the image shows values closer to 0.7-0.8% for the Bund in the left diagram.

errors.text_span: Der Anteil der Länder beginnt bei 2,2 % im Jahr 1995, fällt auf einen Tiefpunkt bei 1,7 % im Jahr 2005 und stabilisiert sich dann wieder bei etwa 2,5 % im Jahr 2023
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values for Länder in the left diagram; the image shows Länder values closer to 0.5-0.7% for most years.

errors.text_span: Der Anteil der Kommunen beginnt bei etwa 2,8 % des BIP im Jahr 1995 und fällt bis 2017 auf etwa 1,8 % des BIP, stabilisiert sich dann aber wieder auf etwa 2,0 % des BIP
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values for Gemeinden in the left diagram; the image shows Gemeinden values closer to 1.0-1.5% for most years.

errors.text_span: Die schwarze Linie beginnt bei etwa 2,5 % im Jahr 1995 und fällt bis 2023 auf etwa 2,0 %
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the black line values; the image shows the black line starting above 3% in 1991 and ending just below 3% in 2023.

errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm stellt den prozentualen Anteil des BIP für verschiedene Entitäten über die Zeit dar
errors.evidence: The description is ambiguous about whether it refers to one or both diagrams and does not specify the type of investments (gross vs. net).

errors.text_span: Die Balken für jedes Jahr sind für jede Entität nebeneinander angeordnet, wobei der Bund am weitesten links, die Länder in der Mitte und die Gemeinden am weitesten rechts liegen
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the structure by not clarifying that this applies only to the left diagram and not the right one.
